head_commit.message:
Rank an open endpoint below an attained tie on exponent boards

current_record() and qualifies_for_run() gave a strict-upper-bound
endpoint the second key -1 on every board, so min() on 3SUM and APSP
chose an endpoint over an attained tie (Worker 2, 2026-10-17).
open_rank() now matches the site rule (site 6fba5f5,
data/direct_import.py): -1 on dft, where max wins, and +1 on the
exponent boards, where min wins. An attained submission at an open
endpoint's score now qualifies for a run on 3SUM and APSP.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
